cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

mechanism: A confidently organizes an overtime challenge but yields B speaking conditions while ensuring B confronts the director before A risks public dissent.
confusable: Unlike shared protest, A keeps exposure conditional on B first attempt; borrowed authority must accommodate the proxy enough to retain cooperation.
comparison: Workplace disciplinary risk and physical support position differ from a club petition whose signature waits for the captain response.
seedUse: Use D56-a director/overtime/discipline/stand-beside chain and S02-b adapting the plan to the participant.
